The determination of the appropriate level of the ACL on loans inherently involves a high degree of subjectivity and requires the Company to make significant judgments concerning credit risks and trends using quantitative and qualitative information, as well as reasonable and supportable forecasts of future economic conditions, all of which may undergo frequent and significant changes.
Management anticipates ongoing expense management of professional services and technology investments will result in continued improvements in operating leverage over time.

Institutions that are deemed to have concentrations in CRE lending are expected to employ heightened levels of risk management with respect to their CRE portfolios and may be required to hold higher levels of capital.
The Company monitors line of credit usage and did not see substantive increases in usage or expected usage during the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026.

estimates.t: The Company’s consolidated financial statements are prepared in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States of America (“GAAP”) and follow general practices within the industries in which it operates.

estimates.name: Allowance for Credit Losses on Loans
estimates.t: The ACL represents management’s best estimate of expected lifetime credit losses within the Company’s loan portfolio as of the balance sheet date.

estimates.name: PERFORMANCE OVERVIEW
estimates.t: The Company’s net income for the third quarter of 2026 was $16.8 million, or $0.50 per diluted common share, compared to net income of $18.9 million, or $0.56 per diluted common share, for the second quarter of 2026.
